column3: Setup: Use the article_preservation testdrive to set up for this test at /testdrive/article_preservation
Setup: This provides a 'no_preservation' account (plain publisher, no preservation role) and a 'with_preservation' account (used by the other tests in this suite)
Setup: At the end of the test suite, use the 'teardown' link provided by the testdrive to remove the test assets from the system
Log in as the 'no_preservation' account supplied by the testdrive
